recap: The table set out to draw a fish, and everyone agreed on it. Maya took the pad first, laying the body from the tail tip while Leo traced the belly along her top edge. Tom waited to add his dorsal fin, and Priya planned a V-notch tail. Then the plan stalled. Maya kept redrawing, and the pad kept changing hands. "The redraw's eating time," Priya warned. Late on, the belly still hadn't joined the start. Maya took the tail joint herself, Leo stayed clear, and Tom patched his loose fin. "We're nearly out of time," Maya wrote. When the facilitator pushed the start domino, only the connected pieces fell. The blind judges guessed ridges and zigzags, not fish. In the end, 34 of 75 fell.
